market_question: Will Eleni Kounalakis win the California Governor Election in 2026?
reasoning: Eleni Kounalakis is the elected Lieutenant Governor of California with high name recognition and an active campaign for the open 2026 gubernatorial race. In a likely top-two primary with several credible Democrats, her chances are well above 0.1%; early polls show her among the top tier, giving her a realistic chance to advance and win. The market price drastically underestimates her probability.
evidence_points: Incumbent Lieutenant Governor with statewide electoral victory in 2018 and 2022.
Actively campaigning and raising funds, with notable endorsements from some Democratic officials.
Early polling (e.g., UC Berkeley Feb 2024) placed her near the top of the Democratic field with 7%, ahead of many others.
